shortDescription: The National Stock Exchange of India’s long-awaited initial public offering is facing a muted finish after a decade-long path to the market, according to Bloomberg. The world’s largest derivatives exchange had been expected to tap investor confidence in India’s long-term growth.

title: NSE IPO Tests India Investor Faith in Long-Term Growth
